tools.name: lookup_account
tools.description: Look up a public account by email; no API key required

tools.name: list_account_articles
tools.description: List an account's published articles; no API key required

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get account quota, balance and recent content

tools.name: create_recharge
tools.description: Create a recharge order for an account email

tools.name: set_promotion
tools.description: Set daily promotion budget; zero pauses

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: lookup_account, list_account_articles · Public sink: lookup_account, publish, create_recharge · Destructive: remove_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: lookup_account, list_account_articles · Public sink: lookup_account, publish, create_recharge · Destructive: remove_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
